name: The Bitter Sweet - Silver lining Releaseparty + Support : Julie Tennefoss
description:
We’re hosting a release party for our upcoming album Silver Lining, out through The Norwegian Sound.  
Produced by Peter Michelsen.
This album represents a new chapter for us — a blend of the sound we’ve built over the years and the direction we’re heading next.

Join us for a night where we premiere tracks from the album, and celebrate the launch together.
We’re excited to finally present Silver Lining live.

Support: Julie Tennefoss
